title: poa elegantula
intro: Poa elegantula, commonly known as Blue Fescue, is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. This perennial grass is native to Europe and Western Asia, and is known for its attractive blue-gray foliage. The health benefits of Poa elegantula include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function due to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties.
